positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Individually contributed to regular, full-stack development work supporting global media distribution
• Individually owned and developed large portions of projects integral to the launch of Disney+
• Produced production level software on a team practicing Agile Software Development (Scrum)
• Delivered several formal demos to other members of the Services team
• Participated in a department-wide Hackathon, winning Most Creative Use of Amazon Web Services

positions.title: Software Engineering Coop
positions.description:
Spring 2019
•	Individually contributed to regular, full-time development work as a full-stack engineer
•	Produced production level software on a team practicing Agile Software Development (Kanban)
•	Formally recruited during career fairs and by delivering a Tech Talk on Georgia Tech’s campus
•	Participated in on-call rotations to get more exposure to full-time work
•	Contributed to several operations and systems that were integral to the business and on strict deadlines

Summer 2018
•	Performed as team lead on another net-new service with cross-departmental stakeholders
•	Managed an internal project using Agile Software (Kanban) Methods and taught these methods to others
•	Delivered several formal demos and presentations to other members of the Engineering Department, and Customer Support
•	Maintained security and compliance across Patientco's and and its vendors' sites

Fall 2017
•	Individually developed a net-new service and designed a search cluster using Elasticsearch and Golang
•	Developed production level software on a team practicing Agile Software Development (Kanban)
•	Participated in a career fair and other follow-up recruiting efforts on behalf of the company
•	Delivered a formal demo and presentation to other members of the Engineering Department and C.S.O.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Formerly a part of MLBAM, BAMTech offers video-on-demand and live-streaming services to its many customers and clients. As a returning member of the team, I worked more as an independent engineer, developing and deploying production-level software in an Agile environment surrounded by full-stack applications.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: As a member of the Multimedia Development team, I started out on smaller scripting projects and soon moved on to work with full-stack systems . My projects at MLBAM all had real applications that benefited the team, and taught me much in terms of software development, the business-user perspective, and the process of productive, team-based development.
